options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380.

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: listZone
options.description: If true, list all records in the zone. If false, only records for the given domain.

options.name: name
options.description: The record or zone name (e.g., test.example.com/example.com). The use of 'domain:' is also supported to align with API.

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.

options.name: zone
options.description: The authoritative zone name (optional, defaults to closest match).
